title: Polynomial of the product circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$, the integer-coefficient multivariate polynomial represented by the circuit constructed to compute the product of the first $n$ factors is $\prod_{i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)}(1+X_i)$, where $X_i$ is the variable corresponding to input $i$.
